title: Tier Presets
description: The 3 tier configurations as pure data.
body: The 3 tier configurations, as `SchematicConfig` values. This file is the proof of PRD §17 Wave 5's acceptance condition — one Schematic engine serves all 3 tiers — held one wave early: nothing below subclasses, branches on the tier at runtime, or reaches into the engine. Each preset is data.
